newsitem.title: UK: UK's Karrimor sells controlling stake to 21 Invest.
newsitem.headline: UK's Karrimor sells controlling stake to 21 Invest.

text.p: Outdoor clothing maker Karrimor International Ltd said on Monday it agreed to a capital injection from 21 Invest that would give the investment firm a controlling stake in the company.
The investment firm includes Italy's Benetton and Bonomi families, among other investors.
The 7.0 million stg funding package of equity and bank financing would be conditional upon 21 Invest's approval of a satisfactory reorganisation plan.
Karrimor said it had sought additional capital resources to secure its financial stability, enabling further development of the business.
"Internationally, the company looks to capitalise on the Benetton connection with 21 Invest to accelerate its growth," the companies said in a statement.
